name: ellipsis-circle-dashed
description: A dashed circle containing three dots.
useCase: Open more actions for a draft item or show an unspecified pending status.
misuse: Describe the actual status in text; a dashed border alone does not define it.

16.reason: The row shifts slightly down and right so all three equal dots remain clear at text size.

24.reason: The full frame and complete status marks retain the same centered layout with larger clear gaps.
